arguments.content:
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

# Elements that must appear AFTER w:u in run properties per schema order
AFTER_U = {
    "w:effect", "w:bdr", "w:shd", "w:fitText", "w:vertAlign",
    "w:rtl", "w:cs", "w:em", "w:lang", "w:eastAsianLayout",
    "w:specVanish", "w:oMath",
}

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
dom = editor.dom


def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeType == t.TEXT_NODE:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    return "".join(parts)


def ensure_underline(rpr):
    existing = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
    if existing:
        existing[0].setAttribute("w:val", "single")
        return
    u = dom.createElement("w:u")
    u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
    for child in rpr.childNodes:
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.tagName in AFTER_U:
            rpr.insertBefore(u, child)
            return
    rpr.appendChild(u)


count = 0
underlined = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    text = para_text(p)
    if text in HEADLINES:
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if rprs:
                rpr = rprs[0]
            else:
                rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
                r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
            ensure_underline(rpr)
        count += 1
        underlined.append(text)

doc.save()
print("underlined:", ", ".join(underlined))
print("count:", count)

from scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

# Elements that must appear AFTER w:u in run properties per schema order
AFTER_U = {
    "w:effect", "w:bdr", "w:shd", "w:fitText", "w:vertAlign",
    "w:rtl", "w:cs", "w:em", "w:lang", "w:eastAsianLayout",
    "w:specVanish", "w:oMath",
}

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
dom = editor.dom


def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeType == t.TEXT_NODE:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    return "".join(parts)


def ensure_underline(rpr):
    existing = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
    if existing:
        existing[0].setAttribute("w:val", "single")
        return
    u = dom.createElement("w:u")
    u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
    for child in rpr.childNodes:
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE and child.tagName in AFTER_U:
            rpr.insertBefore(u, child)
            return
    rpr.appendChild(u)


count = 0
underlined = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    text = para_text(p)
    if text in HEADLINES:
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
            rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
            if rprs:
                rpr = rprs[0]
            else:
                rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
                r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
            ensure_underline(rpr)
        count += 1
        underlined.append(text)

doc.save()
print("underlined:", ", ".join(underlined))
print("count:", count)
